verifiedWith.note: Rule IDs checked by installing plugins in a scratch dir and loading plugin.rules; behaviour probed with ESLint API on upstream Incorrect/Correct blocks.

rules.source: rules/advanced-effect-event-deps.md (## Do Not Put Effect Events in Dependency Arrays)
rules.rule: Do not include a useEffectEvent function in a useEffect dependency array.
rules.gap: Verified: flags the upstream Incorrect block and not the Correct block (react-hooks 7.1.1 recognises Effect Events).

rules.source: rules/advanced-event-handler-refs.md (## Store Event Handlers in Refs)
rules.rule: Store event handlers in refs when used in effects that should not re-subscribe.
rules.gap: Pattern/judgement; superseded by useEffectEvent.

rules.source: rules/advanced-init-once.md (## Initialize App Once, Not Per Mount)
rules.rule: App-wide initialisation must use a module-level guard, not useEffect([]) in a component.
rules.gap: Cannot tell which effect work is app-wide initialisation.

rules.source: rules/advanced-use-latest.md (## useEffectEvent for Stable Callback Refs)
rules.rule: Use useEffectEvent for stable callback refs.
rules.gap: Pattern/judgement.

rules.source: rules/async-api-routes.md (## Prevent Waterfall Chains in API Routes)
rules.rule: In API routes and Server Actions, start independent promises before awaiting any of them.
rules.gap: Needs data-flow/independence analysis between awaited calls.

rules.source: rules/async-cheap-condition-before-await.md (## Check Cheap Conditions Before Async Flags)
rules.rule: In `await flag() && cheapSyncCondition`, evaluate the cheap synchronous condition before the awaited one.
rules.gap: No existing rule; a no-restricted-syntax/custom rule can match LogicalExpression with an AwaitExpression on the left and a non-await on the right (heuristic: cannot know which operand is cheap).

rules.source: rules/async-defer-await.md (## Defer Await Until Needed)
rules.rule: Do not await a value before a branch/early return that does not use it; move the await into the branch that needs it.
rules.gap: No existing rule; custom rule needs scope analysis (awaited variable unused on some paths). Heuristic only.

rules.source: rules/async-dependencies.md (## Dependency-Based Parallelization)
rules.rule: Use `better-all` for operations with partial dependencies instead of chained Promise.all.
rules.gap: Library choice and dependency graph judgement.

rules.source: rules/async-parallel.md (## Promise.all() for Independent Operations)
rules.rule: Independent sequential `await` statements must be combined with Promise.all().
rules.gap: Core eslint/no-await-in-loop only catches the loop variant, which this rule file does not show; the sequential-statements case needs independence analysis.
rules.notes: eslint/no-await-in-loop verified to exist but is a different pattern, so not mapped.

rules.source: rules/async-suspense-boundaries.md (## Strategic Suspense Boundaries)
rules.rule: Use Suspense boundaries instead of awaiting data in the page component before returning wrapper JSX.
rules.gap: Architectural/layout judgement.

rules.source: rules/bundle-analyzable-paths.md (## Prefer Statically Analyzable Paths)
rules.rule: `import()` specifiers and fs paths must be literals or selected from an explicit map, not built from variables.
rules.gap: No rule for dynamic import() specifiers; import-x/no-dynamic-require covers only require(). Custom rule on ImportExpression with non-literal source is straightforward.
rules.notes: Template literals with a fixed prefix are sometimes fine for bundlers, so config needs an allow-list.

rules.source: rules/bundle-barrel-imports.md (## Avoid Barrel File Imports)
rules.rule: Import directly from source files, not from barrel files / library entry points with many re-exports.
rules.gap: barrel-files/avoid-barrel-files flags declaring a barrel, not importing from third-party packages (verified: flagged a 4-line `export *` index file). barrel-files/avoid-importing-barrel-files did NOT flag a local barrel import in my fixture. Third-party barrels (lucide-react etc.) need a no-restricted-imports/patterns list or Next optimizePackageImports.
rules.notes: Config per project: list of known heavy barrel packages.

rules.source: rules/bundle-conditional.md (## Conditional Module Loading)
rules.rule: Load large data/modules only when the feature is activated.
rules.gap: Requires knowing which modules are large and conditional.

rules.source: rules/bundle-defer-third-party.md (## Defer Non-Critical Third-Party Libraries)
rules.rule: Analytics/logging/error-tracking packages must be loaded after hydration (dynamic import), not statically imported.
rules.gap: Custom: no-restricted-imports with a project list of third-party packages and a message pointing to next/dynamic.

rules.source: rules/bundle-dynamic-imports.md (## Dynamic Imports for Heavy Components)
rules.rule: Heavy components (e.g. Monaco, charts) must be loaded with next/dynamic rather than statically imported.
rules.gap: Custom: no-restricted-imports with a project-specific list of heavy modules; "heavy" is not statically knowable.

rules.source: rules/bundle-preload.md (## Preload Based on User Intent)
rules.rule: Preload heavy bundles on hover/focus (user intent) before they are needed.
rules.gap: UX judgement; no statically checkable condition.

rules.source: rules/client-event-listeners.md (## Deduplicate Global Event Listeners)
rules.rule: Share global event listeners across hook instances (useSWRSubscription) instead of one window/document listener per hook call.
rules.gap: Custom heuristic: addEventListener on window/document inside a useEffect of a custom hook. unicorn/web-api-no-leaked-event-listener (@eslint-react) is about cleanup, a different concern.

rules.source: rules/client-localstorage-schema.md (## Version and Minimize localStorage Data)
rules.rule: localStorage keys must carry a version, stored data must be minimal, and access must be wrapped in try/catch.
rules.gap: Custom rules: localStorage.setItem/getItem outside try; key literal without version suffix. "Minimal data" is not checkable.

rules.source: rules/client-passive-event-listeners.md (## Use Passive Event Listeners for Scrolling Performance)
rules.rule: Add `{ passive: true }` to touch and wheel event listeners that do not call preventDefault().
rules.gap: Verified: the upstream example is NOT flagged (handler passed by identifier, or handler passes the event to other functions). Only inline handlers that merely read event properties are flagged.
rules.notes: Still useful as a safety net; rule keeps the passive text in the skill.

rules.source: rules/client-swr-dedup.md (## Use SWR for Automatic Deduplication)
rules.rule: Use SWR (or similar) for request deduplication instead of per-component fetch in effects.
rules.gap: Library choice.

rules.source: rules/js-batch-dom-css.md (## Avoid Layout Thrashing)
rules.rule: Do not interleave style writes with layout reads (layout thrashing).
rules.gap: Needs control-flow/DOM-semantics analysis; unicorn/prefer-observer-apis targets listeners, not this pattern.

rules.source: rules/js-cache-function-results.md (## Cache Repeated Function Calls)
rules.rule: Cache results of repeated pure function calls with a module-level Map.
rules.gap: Requires knowing purity and call frequency.

rules.source: rules/js-cache-property-access.md (## Cache Property Access in Loops)
rules.rule: Cache repeated object property lookups in hot loops.
rules.gap: Performance micro-optimisation; no safe static criterion.

rules.source: rules/js-cache-storage.md (## Cache Storage API Calls)
rules.rule: Cache localStorage/sessionStorage/document.cookie reads in memory.
rules.gap: Needs repetition/hot-path knowledge.

rules.source: rules/js-combine-iterations.md (## Combine Multiple Array Iterations)
rules.rule: Do not chain multiple .filter()/.map() passes over the same array; combine into one loop.
rules.gap: Custom rule on consecutive filter/map over the same identifier; false positives when chains are tiny.

rules.source: rules/js-early-exit.md (## Early Return from Functions)
rules.rule: Return early inside loops/functions once the result is determined.
rules.gap: Requires understanding of intent.

rules.source: rules/js-flatmap-filter.md (## Use flatMap to Map and Filter in One Pass)
rules.rule: Use .flatMap() instead of .map().filter(Boolean).
rules.gap: unicorn/prefer-array-flat-map exists but only handles .map().flat() and .filter().flatMap(); verified it does NOT flag `.map(x=>x.n).filter(Boolean)`. A small no-restricted-syntax selector can.

rules.source: rules/js-hoist-regexp.md (## Hoist RegExp Creation)
rules.rule: Do not create RegExp (literal or constructor) inside component render; hoist to module scope or useMemo.
rules.gap: No existing rule. Custom rule: RegExp literal / new RegExp(literal) inside a component function body.
rules.notes: new RegExp(dynamic) legitimately needs useMemo, so the rule should only flag static patterns.

rules.source: rules/js-index-maps.md (## Build Index Maps for Repeated Lookups)
rules.rule: Multiple `.find()` calls by the same key over the same array should use a Map index.
rules.gap: Custom heuristic: .find inside loop/callback over another array.

rules.source: rules/js-length-check-first.md (## Early Length Check for Array Comparisons)
rules.rule: Check array lengths before expensive array comparison (sort, deep equals).
rules.gap: Needs recognition of "expensive comparison".

rules.source: rules/js-min-max-loop.md (## Use Loop for Min/Max Instead of Sort)
rules.rule: Do not sort an array to find min/max; use a single loop (or Math.min/max).
rules.gap: Verified: flags only `arr.sort((a,b)=>a-b).at(-1)` style (plain numeric comparator). Does NOT flag the upstream examples (`[...p].sort((a,b)=>b.updatedAt-a.updatedAt)[0]`, `sorted[0]`).
rules.notes: Custom selector for `.sort(...)[0]` / `.sort(...)[x.length-1]` would close the gap.

rules.source: rules/js-request-idle-callback.md (## Defer Non-Critical Work with requestIdleCallback)
rules.rule: Defer non-critical work with requestIdleCallback.
rules.gap: Cannot decide what is non-critical.

rules.source: rules/js-set-map-lookups.md (## Use Set/Map for O(1) Lookups)
rules.rule: Use a Set (not Array#includes) for repeated membership checks.
rules.gap: Flags arrays only used for .includes; the Map half (index maps for .find) is the separate rule js-index-maps. Snippet-fragment fixtures verified manually with the upstream example (flagged).
rules.notes: Upstream example is a code fragment so automated block-probe could not parse it; manual probe passed.

rules.source: rules/js-tosorted-immutable.md (## Use toSorted() Instead of sort() for Immutability)
rules.rule: Use .toSorted() instead of mutating .sort().
rules.gap: Verified on upstream Incorrect (flagged) and Correct (not flagged) blocks. Rule also flags `[...a].sort()` which upstream may tolerate for old runtimes.

rules.source: rules/rendering-activity.md (## Use Activity Component for Show/Hide)
rules.rule: Use <Activity> to preserve state/DOM for expensive components that toggle often.
rules.gap: Judgement about "expensive" and "frequent".

rules.source: rules/rendering-animate-svg-wrapper.md (## Animate SVG Wrapper Instead of SVG Element)
rules.rule: Animate a wrapping <div>, not the <svg> element itself.
rules.gap: Custom JSX selector: <svg> with animate-* className/style animation. Class-name conventions are project specific.

rules.source: rules/rendering-conditional-render.md (## Use Explicit Conditional Rendering)
rules.rule: Use ternary (`? :`) instead of `&&` for conditional rendering when the condition can be 0/NaN.
rules.gap: Configure with validStrategies: ["ternary"]. Verified on upstream blocks. Non-type-aware, so it flags every `&&` in JSX, including boolean conditions (stricter than upstream). Type-aware alternative @eslint-react/no-leaked-conditional-rendering exists (ID verified) but requires typed linting; behaviour not tested.
rules.notes: Stricter than upstream text; acceptable or switch to the typed rule.

rules.source: rules/rendering-content-visibility.md (## CSS content-visibility for Long Lists)
rules.rule: Apply CSS content-visibility: auto to long lists.
rules.gap: CSS, not JS; no ESLint hook.

rules.source: rules/rendering-hoist-jsx.md (## Hoist Static JSX Elements)
rules.rule: Static JSX elements must be hoisted out of component functions.
rules.gap: No existing rule; custom rule: JSX element with no references to component scope returned/assigned inside a component. React Compiler does this automatically.

rules.source: rules/rendering-hydration-no-flicker.md (## Prevent Hydration Mismatch Without Flickering)
rules.rule: Use a synchronous inline script to set client-storage-dependent DOM before hydration.
rules.gap: Architecture pattern.

rules.source: rules/rendering-hydration-suppress-warning.md (## Suppress Expected Hydration Mismatches)
rules.rule: Use suppressHydrationWarning on elements with expected server/client mismatch.
rules.gap: Cannot know which mismatches are expected.

rules.source: rules/rendering-resource-hints.md (## Use React DOM Resource Hints)
rules.rule: Use React DOM resource hint APIs (preload, preconnect, prefetchDNS) for known resources.
rules.gap: Requires knowing which resources are needed.

rules.source: rules/rendering-script-defer-async.md (## Use defer or async on Script Tags)
rules.rule: Script tags with src must have defer or async.
rules.gap: Verified on upstream Incorrect (flagged) and Correct (not flagged). The next/script `strategy` advice is advisory and not checked.
rules.notes: Only meaningful in Next.js; plugin is Next-specific.

rules.source: rules/rendering-svg-precision.md (## Optimize SVG Precision)
rules.rule: SVG path coordinates should be reduced to a sensible precision.
rules.gap: Better done by SVGO; as ESLint a custom JSX attribute regex on `d=`.

rules.source: rules/rendering-usetransition-loading.md (## Use useTransition Over Manual Loading States)
rules.rule: Use useTransition instead of manual isLoading useState.
rules.gap: Heuristic naming-based detection only; high false positives.

rules.source: rules/rerender-defer-reads.md (## Defer State Reads to Usage Point)
rules.rule: Do not subscribe to searchParams/localStorage state if only read inside callbacks.
rules.gap: Needs usage analysis of hook result.

rules.source: rules/rerender-dependencies.md (## Narrow Effect Dependencies)
rules.rule: Effect dependency arrays should use primitives, not whole objects.
rules.gap: react-hooks/exhaustive-deps does not require this (it asks for the object itself if the object is used). Custom type-aware rule needed.

rules.source: rules/rerender-derived-state-no-effect.md (## Calculate Derived State During Rendering)
rules.rule: Do not store derived values in state or set state in an effect solely from props/state; derive during render.
rules.gap: Verified: no-derived-state and set-state-in-effect flag the upstream Incorrect block and not the Correct one. no-adjust-state-on-prop-change flagged my own prop-change fixture but not the upstream example (not applicable to it).

rules.source: rules/rerender-derived-state.md (## Subscribe to Derived State)
rules.rule: Subscribe to derived booleans instead of continuous values.
rules.gap: Design judgement.

rules.source: rules/rerender-functional-setstate.md (## Use Functional setState Updates)
rules.rule: Use the functional form setState(prev => ...) when the new value depends on the current state variable.
rules.gap: No existing rule. Custom: call to a useState setter whose argument references the paired state variable.

rules.source: rules/rerender-lazy-state-init.md (## Use Lazy State Initialization)
rules.rule: Pass an initializer function to useState for expensive initial values.
rules.gap: Verified: flags `useState(buildSearchIndex(items))` and `useState(new Map())`; does NOT flag `useState(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(..)))` which is in the upstream example.
rules.notes: Gap case can be added with no-restricted-syntax on useState(JSON.parse(...)).

rules.source: rules/rerender-memo-with-default-value.md (## Extract Default Non-primitive Parameter Value from Memoized Component to Constant)
rules.rule: Do not use non-primitive inline defaults (array/object/function) for props of memoized components; hoist to a constant.
rules.gap: Verified with own fixtures on memo and plain components (flagged inline defaults, passed hoisted constants). The upstream snippets were fragments and did not parse in the automated probe.
rules.notes: Rules flag all components, not only memoized ones (stricter).

rules.source: rules/rerender-memo.md (## Extract to Memoized Components)
rules.rule: Extract expensive work into memoized child components so early returns skip computation.
rules.gap: Refactoring judgement.

rules.source: rules/rerender-move-effect-to-event.md (## Put Interaction Logic in Event Handlers)
rules.rule: Run user-action side effects in the event handler, not via state + effect.
rules.gap: Verified: flags the upstream Incorrect block, not the Correct one. Heuristic plugin; will not catch every state-then-effect shape.

rules.source: rules/rerender-no-inline-components.md (## Don't Define Components Inside Components)
rules.rule: Do not define components inside other components.
rules.gap: Verified: all three flag the upstream Incorrect block and none flag the Correct block. Use one (react/no-unstable-nested-components) to avoid duplicates.

rules.source: rules/rerender-simple-expression-in-memo.md (## Do not wrap a simple expression with a primitive result type in useMemo)
rules.rule: Do not wrap a simple primitive-result expression in useMemo.
rules.gap: Verified react-hooks/use-memo does NOT flag it (it validates misuse, not necessity). Custom rule: useMemo callback whose body is a single expression of only logical/arithmetic/comparison operators on member accesses.

rules.source: rules/rerender-split-combined-hooks.md (## Split Combined Hook Computations)
rules.rule: Split a combined useMemo/useEffect that does independent tasks with different dependencies.
rules.gap: Requires semantic independence analysis.

rules.source: rules/rerender-transitions.md (## Use Transitions for Non-Urgent Updates)
rules.rule: Mark frequent non-urgent state updates as transitions.
rules.gap: Requires knowing urgency.

rules.source: rules/rerender-use-deferred-value.md (## Use useDeferredValue for Expensive Derived Renders)
rules.rule: Use useDeferredValue for expensive derived renders from input.
rules.gap: Requires knowing which render is expensive.

rules.source: rules/rerender-use-ref-transient-values.md (## Use useRef for Transient Values)
rules.rule: Use useRef for frequently changing values that do not need to re-render.
rules.gap: Requires knowing render relevance.

rules.source: rules/server-after-nonblocking.md (## Use after() for Non-Blocking Operations)
rules.rule: Use after() for non-blocking logging/analytics after response.
rules.gap: Cannot tell which awaited calls are non-critical.

rules.source: rules/server-auth-actions.md (## Authenticate Server Actions Like API Routes)
rules.rule: Every "use server" action must verify authentication/authorization inside the action body.
rules.gap: Custom: function in a "use server" module/with the directive that has no call to a configured auth function (e.g. verifySession) before other statements. Project-specific auth function names.

rules.source: rules/server-cache-lru.md (## Cross-Request LRU Caching)
rules.rule: Use an LRU cache for cross-request data sharing.
rules.gap: Architecture choice.

rules.source: rules/server-cache-react.md (## Per-Request Deduplication with React.cache())
rules.rule: Use React.cache() for per-request deduplication of server data functions.
rules.gap: Cannot know which functions are called repeatedly.

rules.source: rules/server-dedup-props.md (## Avoid Duplicate Serialization in RSC Props)
rules.rule: Avoid transforming arrays on the server before passing to client components (breaks reference dedup).
rules.gap: Needs RSC boundary + data-flow analysis.

rules.source: rules/server-hoist-static-io.md (## Hoist Static I/O to Module Level)
rules.rule: Static I/O (reading fonts/logos/config) in route handlers must be hoisted to module level.
rules.gap: Custom: fs.readFile*/fetch of literal path inside a function in a route file. Static-vs-dynamic distinguished by literal args.

rules.source: rules/server-no-shared-module-state.md (## Avoid Shared Module State for Request Data)
rules.rule: Do not mutate module-level variables with request-scoped data in server-rendered code.
rules.gap: Verified: flags reassigning a module-level `let` during render of a component/hook. Does not cover non-component server code (route handlers, utility modules) or mutation of module-level Maps/arrays.

rules.source: rules/server-parallel-fetching.md (## Parallel Data Fetching with Component Composition)
rules.rule: Restructure RSC composition so sibling components fetch in parallel.
rules.gap: Architectural.

rules.source: rules/server-parallel-nested-fetching.md (## Parallel Nested Data Fetching)
rules.rule: Chain dependent nested fetches inside each item promise within Promise.all.
rules.gap: Needs data-flow analysis.

rules.source: rules/server-serialization.md (## Minimize Serialization at RSC Boundaries)
rules.rule: Pass only needed fields across the RSC boundary.
rules.gap: Needs type/usage analysis across components.
